about_the_game:
Wartheon is a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure set in a world on the brink of elemental collapse. When the malevolent sorcerer Moldran tears open a rift to steal the powers of the elemental orders, chaos floods the land. From this rupture, twisted beasts and corrupted creatures pour into Wartheon, warping the balance of nature and plunging the world into peril.

Take control of one of four unique champions — each a master of their own combat style and skill tree — and fight your way through eight perilous levels, each dominated by a sub-boss corrupted by the elemental rift. Every journey is different, with procedurally-generated rooms, randomized loot, and punishing enemy encounters that reward tactical combat and quick reflexes.

Customize your build, master your skills, and adapt to ever-changing layouts and enemy patterns. With multiple playstyles and randomized challenges in each run, Wartheon offers deep replayability for roguelike fans seeking skill-based progression and meaningful decision-making.

Level-Up & Character Stats

In the game, you will level-up when your yelow experience bar at bottom-left filled. When leveled-up, you will get a build point. You can use this build point in order to improve the chracter's build.

Character Special Skills

Every character has 3 unique special skills. For example, Astraues can slam the ground to have AoE or Lyrisa can cast a meteor upon mobs.

NPC Rooms

During the wandering through the dungeon, you will rarely meet NPC rooms. Those NPCs can sell you goods or convice you to play gamble.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen) or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD FX-6300 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
